definition_title: Weighted rectangular cutoffs and volume bounds
natural_language_statement: For k > 0, positive coordinate weights κ, and T > 0, rectangularCutoff κ T i is the natural ceiling of T / (k κ i). Each coordinate below its cutoff has weighted size less than T / k, so the total weighted size is less than T. The bundle also proves positivity of each cutoff, a lower bound of 2 when k κ i < T, and the product lower bound T^k / ((k : ℝ)^k ∏ i, κ i) ≤ ∏ i, (rectangularCutoff κ T i : ℝ).
explanation: The definition turns a real scale T and positive coordinate weights into a finite rectangular range of natural coordinates. The selected estimates control individual and total weighted coordinates and give a product estimate for the resulting side lengths under the stated positivity assumptions.
